title: Annotatio II §.III open: Consubstantiation history — CONCEPTIO, NATIVITAS, PERDURATIO
pass_a_gloss: §. III. The History of either Consubstantiation, to be handed down through some little Compendium, we shall comprehend in three moments only, of which the first narrates Consubstantiation’s CONCEPTION; the Second, its NATIVITY; the Third, its DURATION.
pass_b_english: §.III: both kinds of Consubstantiation get a short history in three moments.
source_text: §. III. Utriusque Consubstantiationis Historiam, per Compendiolum aliquod tradendum, tribus admodum momentis comprehendemus, quorum primum Consubstantiationis CONCEPTIONEM; Secundum, NATIVITATEM; Tertium, PERDURATIONEM enarrat.
